items.title: Dave Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, Connecticut, November 21, 2001
items.q: he’s asking six composers to write a section after each composer... And I did it... I went to the performance. All six composers were in London and we all had to go on stage.

ctx.x: Isn’t that so interesting that your first reaction is, “oh please.” But I can just see the way you must work, it’s like it gets in there and something starts stirring around.

And then just before that a solo violinist named Simon Blendis, B-L-E-N-D-I-S, said he’s taking Bach “Partita” and it’s I think six movements, and he’s asking six composers to write a section after each composer. And again I’m thinking oh I don’t want to get involved in this. And I did it. And he’s played it. I went to the performance. All six composers were in London and we all had to go on stage.
